description: This file defines the `TimeUntilDisconnectNotification` class, which represents information about a device indicating readiness to receive upstream messages, including methods for creating instances from messages, getting various properties, and calculating expiry times.

classes.name: TimeUntilDisconnectNotification
classes.description: Contains all information about a device that indicates being ready to receive an upstream message, including creation from messages and expiry calculations.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance of `TimeUntilDisconnectNotification` from an AMQP message, extracting properties such as TTD, tenant ID, device ID, and creation time.

methods.name: getMillisecondsUntilExpiry
methods.description: Calculates the remaining milliseconds until the notification expires based on 'readyUntil' time.
